verdict.rationale: Metorial supports reviewing automation activity (traces, sessions, tool calls, failures) and lets you pin provider deployments to a specific version to prevent automatic updates, giving some review/versioning capability. However there is no evidence of version history, diffing, or rollback specifically for 'Magic Skills' (the packaged automations/workflows) — only provider/integration deployments are versioned, not the automations themselves. Missing for 10: skill/workflow version history, explicit rollback mechanism for automations, changelog/diff view for skills.
